objective: Strengthen and scrutinize the scientific claims of PART3 before publication.

claims.claim: Function-value Hessian regularity is known; the compact constrained affine model is our specialization.
claims.resolution: Corrected the former introduction attribution; no model novelty claim.

claims.claim: Existing halving/doubling FW and AFW have the stated separated certificate and total-trial bounds, including initialization and final verification.
claims.priority: Specialized analysis; no first-algorithm or exhaustive-priority claim.

claims.claim: The differential envelope E(delta) is the smallest universal bound depending only on D,H0,H1,delta for the stated class; one-dimensional convex C2 functions attain every branch and parameter tuple.
claims.limits: Pointwise sharpness is proved by extremizers. This is not optimal oracle complexity or a proof of bibliographic priority.

claims.claim: When H0=0 the entire constrained solution set is an exposed face with a common gradient; gradient variation is at most H1 D delta/2. Finite atoms imply weak sharpness.
claims.limits: A nonconstant objective cannot have a relative-interior optimum. Weak sharpness need not hold on a disk; this is not an unrestricted interpolation-loss model.

claims.claim: Backtracking AFW terminates at an exact optimum in finitely many updates when H0=0 and the atom set is finite, without an additional geometric inequality. The explicit bound separates initialization lag from the phase cost.
claims.limits: Exact arithmetic and exact oracles; finite identification is prior. No finite-precision termination guarantee or extension to H0>0 is asserted.

claims.claim: Under a global R^d Hessian/value bound and finite global infimum, gradient norm squared is at most 2H0 delta+H1 delta^2; quadratics, cosh and exponential functions attain the constants.
claims.limits: The compact constrained model alone does not imply this inequality; a nonconstant affine function is a counterexample. This does not transfer the source papers convergence theorems automatically.

claims.claim: The 756 method records share 108 cases; failures and matched budgets remain included. No uniform advantage, wall-time superiority or independent-replication inflation is asserted.
claims.limits: The rational geometry audits are theorem checks, not new real-data benchmarks. Numerical references are not directed-rounding interval certificates.

A targeted source comparison does not establish absolute bibliographic priority.

comparison_summary: Mathematical sharpness is proved by attaining functions. The targeted literature comparison supplies attribution and explicit bound comparisons, not a claim of absolute priority.
revision_scope: Editorial attribution and primary-source comparison updated; main article numbered mathematical statements unchanged. Separate lower-bound notes corrected and independently checked by finite internal tests.
